author: WP20
summary: Alpha.1-era description of cna-samples and cna-examples as complementary evidence. Its counts (63/23/67), its definition of done, the SimpleAnimation story and the cna-examples renderer-name complaint are stale at the site's pins (cna-samples 4da98a0, cna-examples ea33c9a). The site already had the pinned counts and the maintainer workflow; the completion gates, source ranking, re-port evidence, cna-examples verification forms and the triangulation rule now live on the porting case-studies page.

concepts.text: cna-samples (official XNA samples translated) and cna-examples (a CNA-native catalogue) answer different questions; neither replaces CNA's tests, and their status prose needs its pinned revision and evidence type.
cna-samples tracks the official XNA Game Studio 4.0 collection (Ms-PL), builds against sibling CNA and sharp-runtime checkouts on next, and builds each sample as its own executable.

Claim of 63 completed ports, 23 placeholders and 67 ignored entries: at 4da98a0 the plan has 153 rows, 87 complete, 49 awaiting owner decisions, 14 documented non-ports, 2 in progress and Racing Game on a separate plan; 40 are published at samples.libcna.com.
concepts.note: Corrected to the pinned counts; the old split is historical.

target.evidence: cna-samples @4da98a0 plan.md (Progress at a glance; recount of SAMPLE rows)

concepts.text: Claim that Done means only source plus a build target: completion now needs seven gates, including original evidence under real XNA, a native OPENGLES3 comparison and a real-browser WEBGL2 run.

target.evidence: cna-samples @4da98a0 plan.md (Definition of done for one sample)

concepts.text: The SimpleAnimation correction: the row is now re-ported from official XNB files and compared with real XNA (99.96-99.98% of pixels within 8 levels natively, 99.74% in WEBGL2) with nothing changed in CNA for it.
concepts.note: Corrected: the earlier 'two CNA defects found on re-review' story is superseded by the re-port record.

concepts.section: Read each missing file as a dated case record
concepts.text: Each sample's missing.md is an audit record, not a waiver: it names substitutions, reader gaps, fallbacks and defects per program, which is better evidence than a top-level ratio.

target.evidence: cna-samples @4da98a0 plan.md (No-workaround and fidelity policy); 163 missing.md files at the pin

concepts.section: Read each missing file as a dated case record
concepts.text: Old reasons age (the old plan said XNB was unsupported), so historical labels are evidence to re-check: read the old reason, find the current API and test, then port or replace the reason.
tokens: evidence to re-check, not current conclusions
concepts.note: Corrected: the plan itself now mandates a fresh audit of every row.

concepts.text: Official samples combine API calls in the order and lifecycle Microsoft taught, so they find default-state, winding, component-timing, asset-transformation and whole-game renderer problems that unit tests isolate away.

A translated sample is not automatically an independent oracle: a port can misread the C#, replace assets or skip scenes, so it is strong evidence only with the running original and retained captures.
tokens: limit of a sample as an oracle

concepts.text: Claim that only two plan entries have MonoGame counterparts: the current plan ranks MonoGame ports only as supplemental evidence below the original, a running original, FNA and documentation.
concepts.note: The 'two entries' count was not reproduced; the page states the plan's source ranking instead.

concepts.text: cna-examples is one application with 13 areas, 79 categories and 249 demo screens; --list-demos is authoritative and tools/check_catalog.py checks README, plan, screen files and registrations agree.
concepts.note: Pin moved from fa0b49a to ea33c9a; counts unchanged.

concepts.text: Screens support --demo path or substring, --keys scripting, --frames runs that ignore real input, and --screenshot; the Framework sweep checks global state is restored (back buffer 800x600 back to 960x640).

concepts.section: A screenshot sweep needs semantic companions
concepts.text: cna-examples separates verification forms: real hardware input and audio, Xvfb sweeps for Framework and Media, claim programs for Math, CNJ and XACT, self-checking 3D screens, and explanatory screens for absent devices.

concepts.section: A screenshot sweep needs semantic companions
concepts.text: Because a screen that catches its own exception still paints a clean page, a screenshot checker only detects blank or overflowing output; claim programs or self-checks decide correctness.

concepts.section: The pinned documentation uses obsolete renderer names
concepts.text: Claim that cna-examples' README uses the retired backend-named option with EASYGL: at ea33c9a it uses CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER with OPENGLES3, though its override list still names an identity CNA has since retired.
concepts.note: Corrected for the newer pin; the retired name is not repeated.

concepts.section: The pinned documentation uses obsolete renderer names
concepts.text: On the 2D-only SDL_RENDERER the 3D area explains its unavailability instead of throwing; the recorded 249/249 sweeps are dated repository records, so revalidation should update selectors and keep screenshots and tool output.
tokens: explains its unavailability instead of throwing

concepts.text: Triangulate: learn from examples, assess migration risk from samples, and localise by disagreement (native passes/port fails = translation; one renderer fails = renderer; both differ from XNA = bring an oracle); examples demonstrate, samples integrate, tests decide.

issues.text: Official-sample coverage is evidence for CNA next of 2026-09-20 only: 87 of 153 complete at cna-samples 4da98a0, 49 awaiting owner decisions, 14 non-ports; no TARGET build and no CNA CI job builds samples.
cna-examples @ea33c9a README's renderer override list names an identity CNA has since retired (sibling documentation drift).
